summary_md:
# Efter två katastrofer kan bolaget ta revansch

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-07-10  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This DI Kort & Lång episode (published 2026-07-10) previews the Q2 reporting season. The market is shrugging off the US-Iran conflict, while US 30-year yields sit at post-2009 highs. The hosts cover property company reports (Eastnine rose after an acquisition), Byggmax, the niche bank Avida (formerly TF Bank), Ellos's weak IPO and Telenor's low 22% premium bid for Bahnhof. They also discuss Clas Ohlson looking expensive after strong June sales, Revolution Race's well-received purchase of ICANIWILL, and the risk of setbacks in bank reports. Their picks for next week are AFRY's recovery and a possible comeback for Nelly, and they are wary of red flags around Sivers' lock-up. Overall the view is cautious, with high expected profits at about 19x earnings versus a 10-year average of about 16x.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 EAST — Eastnine | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Cited colleague Robert Andersson's late-June buy call; a SEK 2.6bn Polish acquisition sent the share up 5%, now +7%.

#### Reasoning

This is a DI colleague's call, not the hosts'. The acquisition he anticipated has happened and the share reacted well. Property reports suggest a possible trend reversal after an H1 sector fall of about 8%. Exposure is to the Baltics and Poland.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the property sector downturn resumes
- if rising rates pressure property valuations
- if the acquisition fails to be accretive

> *"Eastnine som har fastigheter i Baltikum och Polen som vår kollega Robert Andersson rekommenderade köp och här i slutet av juni."*

---

### 🟠 BMAX — Byggmax | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Good cost control and a strong balance sheet, but large projects remain weak; the hosts expect a lukewarm high season and a pickup only next year.

#### Reasoning

Host Agneta says the report was uneventful: revenue in line, profit slightly better. Consumers are cautious on big renovations, new mortgage rules make home-equity borrowing harder and the extended ROT tax deduction has lapsed. Positioned for an upturn ('när det väl vänder'), but not yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the high season disappoints further
- if the balance sheet weakens
- if consumer demand for large projects does not recover in 2027

> *"Så när det väl vänder kan det nog bli ganska bra."*

---

### 🟡 TFBANK — Avida (fd TF Bank) | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Strong report: profit +31%, ROE 24%, strongest ever German credit-card demand in June; DI's buy call is up 18%.

#### Reasoning

Agneta, who made DI's buy call in August, says to stay in, but notes much of the upside is already realised. The model is scalable and the risk-adjusted margin improved even as credit losses rose. Lending must grow about 20% a year to hit SEK 35bn. More upside in a stronger market.

#### Sell Triggers

- if credit losses rise faster than the risk-adjusted margin
- if lending growth falls below ~20%
- if German credit-card demand fades

> *"Jag tror vi hänger kvar så att säga, men mycket av det här stora är ju gjort."*

---

### 🟠 ELLOS — Ellos | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Weak IPO now trading around the offer price. Former bondholders will likely sell eventually, an overhang on the share.

#### Reasoning

The hosts think it is a question of when, not if, bondholder owners sell. That overhang will likely weigh on the share and make it hard to hold current levels unless results are very strong. Explicitly put on the watchlist.

#### Sell Triggers

- if bondholders start selling after lock-up
- if the first reports disappoint

> *"Så jag tror ändå att det här kommer att hänga över Ellos och det blev ju ingen succénotering får man väl säga."*

---

### ⛔ CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Strong June sales (+14% organic), but the share looks too expensive given management's 5% growth target; profit-taking and a plateau are expected.

#### Reasoning

The host says the valuation looks too high when management itself targets only 5% organic growth. June was boosted by calendar effects, more stores and a heatwave. Analysts will struggle to raise forecasts, so the share likely plateaus.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the company proves sustained growth well above 5%
- if forecasts are raised materially

> *"Det här ser för dyrt ut och när ledningen inte själva tror på att de ska växa mer än 5 % över sikt så vet jag inte varför jag heller ska göra det."*

---

### 🟢 RVRC — Revolution Race | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

The ICANIWILL deal changes how RVRC should be viewed: a new growth leg bought at a lower multiple than RVRC's own ('vinst till reapris'), and the share rose rightly.

#### Reasoning

Host Julia calls the deal logical and very interesting. ICANIWILL is fast-growing and profitable in adjacent training wear, with European expansion where RVRC has experience. Acquisitions are now in RVRC's toolbox as its organic growth slows; a selective, serial-acquirer approach with a strong balance sheet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if RVRC overpays for future acquisitions
- if the balance sheet weakens
- if ICANIWILL growth stalls

> *"Jag tycker att det här är en affär som helt förändrar hur man ska se på Revolution Race."*

---

### 🟢 AFRY — AFRY | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Agneta's September buy call is down 30%, but she hopes and believes Q2 margin exceeds 7% as the recovery programme bears fruit.

#### Reasoning

There have been five straight misses, and the reorganisation brought staff departures. Agneta thinks profitability is edging up, with Q2 EBIT margin above 7% versus 6.6% a year ago and a 10% target. She holds the call but admits she was too optimistic on timing ('hålla tummarna').

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q2 misses expectations a sixth time
- if margin stays near 6-7%
- if staff departures escalate

> *"Jag både hoppas och tror att faktiskt Afry kan klara av att prestera lite bättre här under andra kvartalet."*

---

### 🟠 NELLY — Nelly | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

After two disastrous reports (about -40% each), peers Boozt and Bubbleroom show strong preliminary numbers; a big move either way is expected on the report.

#### Reasoning

Host Julia hopes for a comeback, since peers' strong figures suggest better industry conditions. If Nelly lags its peers, another big fall is likely. This is a speculative, binary event on the report.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Q2 report again disappoints while peers are strong

> *"Efter två fullständiga katastrofer så tror jag att det kanske ändå kan bli en revansch nu."*

---

### ⛔ SIVE — Sivers Semiconductors | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Governance red flags: a share issue broke the lock-up and management signed no new one. The report moved to 27 Aug opens a 16-27 July insider selling window; the photonics chief sold his stake.

#### Reasoning

The hosts are irritated that the report delay seems to let management sell. Orders have not been quantified and the photonics chief sold everything. The CEO and board buying (possibly via incentive programmes) is a mixed signal. Main risk: insider selling after the lock-up expires.

#### Sell Triggers

- if management does not sell after lock-up
- if the report quantifies orders convincingly

> *"Och att då flytta fram det ytterligare en bit tycker jag, det känns inte bra."*

---
